Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

X-Request-Id.description: This response's id (req_ followed by 20 hex digits). Error bodies repeat it as error.request_id.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable; the message is for people and may change.

cost_usd.description: The charge once succeeded, 0 once failed, else null.

error.description: When failed. message is written to show the person who asked; retryable says whether the same request can work later.

reason.description: Only on content_policy: the rule the model cited.

retryable.description: true: send the same request again later. false: the request has to change.

message.description: Only while a result is being confirmed with a provider.

output.description: Null until succeeded. urls lists every file (a picture model can return several, a music model two: /content, /content/2, ...). Pictures carry width and height; videos also duration_s and has_audio; audio carries duration_s (the first file) and durations_s (each).

durations_s.description: Audio only: the length of each file in urls, in order.

quoted_usd.description: The price on the route tried first. If a dearer backup route makes it instead, the charge is that route's price, up to reserved_usd.

reserved_usd.description: Held from the balance while it runs: the dearest route that may run, so the most it can cost. Set max_cost_usd to quoted_usd to skip dearer backups.

input.description: SeedanceInput for seedance-2.5. NemesisInput for nemesis (a 4-30 s clip, rendered as a Seedance 2.5 edit at its rate plus $0.02 a second) and nemesis-lite (a 2-15 s clip, rendered on Wan 3.0 at its rate plus $0.02 a second); both are billed per second of clip in plus video out. ModelInput for every other model. Unknown fields, and values the model does not offer, are refused with 422 invalid_input before anything is charged.

max_cost_usd.description: The most this generation may cost. Routes above it are skipped.

max_wait_s.description: Routes expected to take longer than this many seconds are skipped, and once it has passed no new route is tried. A route already running may finish (up to 40 minutes) and is charged if it delivers.

task.description: What to do with input.video_url, on video models. video_edit changes the clip and keeps its length (seedance-2.5, wan-2.7-videoedit, wan-2.7, happyhorse-1.0, kling-3.0-omni, kling-4.0, wan-3.0); video_extend continues it (pixverse-v6). Only the routes that do that task are used; a model without one answers 422 invalid_input naming the models that do. Leave it out to keep each model's own behaviour. Also accepted as input.task.

ModelInput.description: The input of every model other than seedance-2.5. Which fields and values a model takes, and its defaults, are in /data/models.json (options, tasks, price).

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's aspect ratios, e.g. 16:9, 9:16, 1:1.

audio.description: Generate sound, on models that offer it. Changes the price on some models.

audio_url.description: A sound to drive the video (talking avatars, lip sync).

duration.description: Video length in seconds: one of the model's durations. Per-second models are billed for it.

end_image_url.description: The last frame, on models with first and last frame. Needs image_url.

image_url.description: The start frame (image to video) or the picture to edit (image to image).

image_urls.description: Reference pictures, up to the model's max_input_images.

instrumental.description: Music models only: true for no vocals. Not with lyrics.

lyrics.description: Music models only: the words to sing. Not with instrumental.

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid, on models that take it.

num_images.description: Picture models only: how many pictures to make, up to the model's options.max_images in /data/models.json (usually 4). Also accepted as n. The price and the hold are per picture; only the pictures delivered are charged, the rest is released. output.urls lists them all.

prompt.description: What to generate. Required unless the model only transforms media (an upscaler).

quality.description: A quality tier, on models that price by one (e.g. low, medium, high).

resolution.description: One of the model's resolutions, e.g. 720p, 1080p, 1K, 2K, 4K.

seed.description: A seed, on models that take one.

style.description: Music models only: the genre and sound, such as "indie folk, warm vocals". A music request needs style or lyrics; prompt (at most 3000 characters there) is the idea.

video_url.description: A clip to transform or extend, on models that take one. Its length is measured and may be billed.

NemesisInput.description: Input for nemesis: restages a clip with your people, products and places (its movement, timing and camera, played by the references). Priced at a Seedance 2.5 edit's rate plus $0.02 a second, per second of the clip in plus the video out. The result keeps the clip's length and shape.

face_mesh.description: Traces every face in the clip so the new face keeps its expressions, eyes and lips; never shown in the result. nemesis-lite only. Default: true with guide people, false with scene and clip.

guide.description: nemesis-lite only (nemesis always edits the clip itself). clip (default with a target frame): follows the clip's own picture. people (default without one): the people are replaced and the background kept (a clip with nobody in it is refused, not charged). scene: everything seen comes from the references and prompt.

roles.description: One per picture, in order. Default: every picture is a person.

sound.description: original (default on nemesis): the clip's own sound is put back on the result. none (default on nemesis-lite): a silent result.

target_frame.description: Before the render, the clip's first frame is redrawn with the change already made, in the same pose, size and light, and sent as the first reference, so hair, face and clothes stay true to the pictures. Default: true for nemesis, false for nemesis-lite. Free.

detail.description: The message again, where fal clients look for it.

available_usd.description: With a customer key: what the account can spend now.

enough_credit.description: With a customer key: whether available_usd covers reserved_usd, so a create would not be refused 402.

estimated_seconds.description: How long the first route usually takes.

quoted_usd.description: The price of the route tried first: what a successful generation normally costs.

reserved_usd.description: The hold a create would take: the most it can be charged if a dearer backup route delivers. Never above max_cost_usd.

items.description: A public https URL that downloads directly.

image_url.description: Exact first frame. Not with reference media.

info.description: One API key for image and video models. Prepaid credits, 100 credits = $1; only the route that succeeds is charged. Every model in /data/models.json takes the same request shape: `input` is SeedanceInput for seedance-2.5 and ModelInput for the others, whose allowed values, defaults and prices are listed per model in /data/models.json. An unknown model id answers 422 model_not_available; a model whose routes are all down at the moment, 503 model_unavailable. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header (req_ followed by 20 hex digits); every error body repeats it as error.request_id, so quote it when asking for help. Every error has a stable machine-readable error.code; every 429 and 503 carries Retry-After in seconds. Price a request first with POST /v1/generations/quote (free; nothing is created or held). Retrying: after a timeout or a 5xx on a create, resend the same body with the same Idempotency-Key, which returns the generation already made instead of starting (and charging) another. After a generation has failed, start again with a new key: the old key keeps answering the failed generation.
info.title: Revana API

parameters.description: Resending the same key and body returns the same generation instead of starting another. The same key with a different body is 409 idempotency_conflict. Make one key per request, once (a UUID), and send it again on every resend after a timeout, a dropped connection, a 429 or a 5xx: the request is never made or charged twice. After a generation has failed, send it again with a new key: the old one keeps answering the failed generation.

get.description: No key needed. Every model /v1/generations accepts at this moment, with its tasks, options and price (the same fields as /data/models.json). A model missing here answers 422 model_not_available. With a customer key (Authorization: Bearer sr_live_...), prices are that account's own (its price book) and the response carries X-Revana-Price-Book; without one, the public prices. Language models (kind text) are listed too; they run on /v1/chat/completions, not /v1/generations. Prices listed per second are the plain rates: some inputs cost more (Seedance 2.5 with a first frame is $0.11 / $0.25 / $0.55 a second), so price a specific request with POST /v1/generations/quote.
